concept.description: Labels methods and types annotated with a Resilience4j annotation as :ResilienceGuarded.
concept.cypher: MATCH (x)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(at:Type) WHERE (x:Method OR x:Type) AND at.fqn IN ['io.github.resilience4j.retry.annotation.Retry', 'io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.annotation.CircuitBreaker', 'io.github.resilience4j.bulkhead.annotation.Bulkhead', 'io.github.resilience4j.timelimiter.annotation.TimeLimiter', 'io.github.resilience4j.ratelimiter.annotation.RateLimiter'] SET x:ResilienceGuarded RETURN count(DISTINCT x) AS Guarded

group.description: tech-resilience4j - retry / circuit breaker / bulkhead / time limiter / rate limiter
